sources.summary: Located in São José do Rio Preto , in the interior of São Paulo, this 680 m² (7,320 sq ft) residence was designed by Solange Cálio Arquitetos for a couple of doctors and their two daughters, accommodating both their daily routine and frequent visits from their eldest daughter, who lives abroad.
